title: Each Spoke Maintains Its Own Metadata via Self-Registry Skill
description: Spokes self-declare what they are, what they do, and what expertise they offer. Self-registry skill validates and updates .spoke-metadata.yaml locally on each spoke. Hub aggregates these declarations on wakeup.
perceive: Spokes need a way to declare themselves. Hub needs accurate, current information about who does what. Registry can't be manually edited (it goes stale).
execute: Created framework/skills/self-registry.yaml. Each spoke creates .spoke-metadata.yaml (from template). Self-registry validates and updates it locally with current state.
verify: Each spoke's .spoke-metadata.yaml contains: mission, scope, domains, boundaries, expertise, stack, activity metrics (commits, lugs, sessions).
resolution_reason: Each spoke is source of truth about itself. Self-registry skill ensures metadata stays current. Hub aggregates on wakeup.
